title: The Legend of the Missing Cartridge

scenes.text: What happened to the 1992 Saeko cartridge mystery?
Many think the game vanished because the publisher cancelled it.
scenes.label: Cancelled Publisher Theory

scenes.text: In reality the cartridge was delayed by supply issues, not a cancellation, and a limited run finally shipped in 2024.
scenes.label: Supply Delay, Not Cancelled

scenes.text: Supply chain hiccups can hide games from fans.
scenes.label: Supply Chain Hiccup
scenes.sub: Delays, not bans, keep titles hidden

scenes.text: Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: Uncover why the Saeko dating‑sim cartridge seemed lost and the real reason it finally appeared. Follow for more gaming mysteries.
